PLAN "Post-Illness Reconditioning Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Return to pre-illness baseline: bench 100, squat 140, deadlift 170"
  GOAL secondary conditioning:
    name "Rebuild work capacity and recover lost bodyweight"

PHASES
  PHASE "Reconditioning" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lunge 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning and Pump":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x40 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x4..5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lunge 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning and Pump":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
          chest_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x3..4 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lunge 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Conditioning and Pump":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

I can't give exact loads in this format. WPL-AI has no load field, so the compiler can't store them. Here are working estimates for Week 1 as a guide:

- **Bench (3x8..10, RPE 6):** about 60–65 kg
- **Squat (3x8..10, RPE 6):** about 95–105 kg
- **Deadlift (3x5..6, RPE 6):** about 120–130 kg

These assume he's still recovering from the flu and has lost 4 kg, so start at the low end of each range. Stop each set with about 3–4 reps in reserve. If the first session feels easy, add 2.5–5 kg for week 2. If he's still fatigued or the RPE is hard to hit, hold the weights.
